title: Changes in gambling severity, stress response and epigenetic regulation of the oxytocin and dopamine system in gambling addiction before and after metacognitive training
summary: Ein Risikofaktor für die Entstehung und Aufrechterhaltung von pathologischem Spielverhalten ist psychischer bzw. sozialer Stress.

interventions.name:
Eight sessions "metacognitive training for problematic gambling". This training consists of eight modules:
Attribution
Probabilities I
Self-esteem
Probabilities II
Memory
Coping with craving
Debt regulation
Relapse prevention

One sessions lasts 60-100 minutes with 3-12 participants. They

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients:
- age ≥ 18 years
- diagnosis of "gambling disorder" according to DSM-5
- gambling behavior anytime during the last 28 days

Healthy controlls:
- age ≥ 18 years
Exclusion criteria:
Patients:
- age < 18 years
- insuffienct knowledge of the German language
- excessive gambling during a psychotic or manic episode
- inability  to give informed consent
- substance-related addiction except tobacco

Healthy controls:
- age below 18 years 
- substance-related addiction except tobacco, mental disorders
- inability to give informed consent
- no subordination/dependency to the study personel
